maxyNotes.title: Released to the alliance
maxyNotes.body: Released to the alliance and metal visitors who are still over, any questions let me know. Rift wall break calculator is my current focus so there is no more guessing, will expand on it down the line so it can also calculate your losses in the cy. Currently just in the leaders corner tools.

maxyNotes.title: Planned
maxyNotes.body: Planned — Boss specific guides + tool usage, PvP attacking guide + tooling, in-depth Defence guide. Locked-off section for leaders only at the moment, contains a few tools I don't want leaked at this time — so PM me for a code and I might say yes.

maxyNotes.title: Work in progress
maxyNotes.body: Links only shared to Chemies members. Send me a PM in-game / DM if you want anything specific added, want more images, or want to contribute a guide or calculator of your own. Cheers, Maxy

changelog.title: Rift rework is LIVE (v781.02) — real booster numbers, 4 new gear sets
changelog.body: The 29 Jul Rift Raid rework shipped. Data across the site auto-refreshed to v781.02, and the guides now carry the real details instead of placeholders: the three alliance combat-booster tiers with actual costs (Common +100%, Rare +250%, Legendary +350% attack; 500 up to 81,000 Rift Coins), and the four new CROSS-EVENT gear sets that dropped — Eastern Raiders (front/flank attack), Samurai (travel speed + survivors), Berimond (XP/plunder), and Glory (Necromancer infection-rate), bought with Rift Shards in the event shop. The quest pool tripled (720 to 2,256). Value rule of thumb added to the guide: everyone hit 250 points per boss level, ride the level track to your division cap, boosters up to Rare, then coast.

changelog.title: Spenders Corner — back on the auto-refresh, and honest about price age
changelog.body: Root cause of the staleness found: Spenders Corner was the one tool never wired into the daily data refresh, so its offer catalogue only updated when someone ran the build by hand. It's now part of refresh-all (which also keeps Item Value Finder current). The hand-captured AUD shop prices can't be automated — they need someone with the in-game shop open — so the page now reads the real capture date from the data instead of a hardcoded 'June 2026', and shows a clear warning once it's over a month old. Right now it's flagging 45 days.

changelog.title: Rift rework incoming (29 Jul) — new Event Shop tool + guides updated
changelog.body: GGS is dropping a big Rift Raid rework: leaders now CHOOSE the boss, alliance combat boosters bought with Alliance Coins, new boss loot, and 1,500+ new quests. New Rift Event Shop overview lists all 141 packages across the blacksmith stalls (Rift Coin, Rift Shard, rubies, Legendary Rift Coin) plus the separate Ducat Shop, with exact prices — and it reads the game files directly, so new stock appears by itself. Checked the shop against older game builds: the ONLY new stock is the four Dominator booster tools (wall/gate debuff + Rift Points in one slot; the Veteran Banner is the 1,000-ruby premium variant). Rift Raid + Tournament guides updated with boss selection, the shop, boosters, the new 32-unit minimum on boss attacks, lowered defeat thresholds, and the auto-clearing of leftover Rift Points.

changelog.title: Rift Tournament Level Rewards — the full 30-level track decoded
changelog.body: New tab in the Rift Tournament Rewards overview: every level reward with its exact point threshold (2,000 → 87,000) and the division you need to unlock it — Copper caps at level 5, Diamond runs to 30. Each 5-level block ends in a Riftsliver Relic PO deco, and each level-up also banks +2 quest tickets. Turns out the level tables ARE in the game files after all, so nothing here is guesswork.

changelog.title: Rift Tournament rewards — every division decoded (new overview)
changelog.body: The Tournament is back live, but in-game you can only see your own division's rewards. So we pulled the lot from the game files: a new Rift Tournament Rewards overview lists every ranking reward for all six divisions rank by rank — the Diamond winner's 1,000,000 rubies + permanent +6-wave amulet, the +1,200–1,500% recruitment crests, the boosted Distribution-phase Copper table this run pays out, and more. The guide got a matching pass: relaunch quest-ticket rules, the 250-point eligibility floor, real promotion/demotion counts and this season's seeding cutoffs (top 36 → Gold).

changelog.title: Spenders Corner — offer classes, honest bonuses & the spender-tier ladder
changelog.body: Deep dive into the game's own offer tables. Every sale is now classed 🛒 shop rotation / ⚡ pop-up engine / 🕰️ retired, straight from the client data. Pop-up offers show the REAL contents-worth bonus next to the splashed one (the +500% banner is usually +400% by the game's own numbers — 1,467 of 1,524 pop-ups overstate). And the new spender-tier ladder exposes offer targeting: 20 tiers of deals gated by your lifetime rubies bought, from A$2.77 starter hooks to A$179.99 whale bundles.

changelog.title: Images everywhere, clickable rewards & a smarter Spenders Corner
changelog.body: Buildings overview got real building art (105/112) and the rift bosses their portraits — all straight from the game's own files. Any catalogued reward in the Gacha Simulator and Item Value Finder is now clickable and jumps to its overview entry. Spenders Corner rebuilt its relevance logic: the sale search now cross-checks the game's own shop catalogue, so by default you see the bundles actually on sale right now instead of the retired back-catalogue.

changelog.title: Site-wide tune-up — 20+ fixes across the archive
changelog.body: Full audit of all 52 tools: Construction Items overview now shows real item icons (240 of 241), share-preview cards on every tool page, a defence-survival multi-wave bug squashed (post-breach waves now reach the keep), correct level brackets on Rankings, the rift overview links straight to the Wall-Break sim, plus a stack of small input-handling and error-state fixes.

changelog.title: Rift Tournament guide — full rework
changelog.body: Updated with Goodgame's official reveal: the six divisions (Copper→Diamond), Rift Points, the real quest-ticket rules (2 to start, +2 per boss kill), and every Riftsliver reward with exact stats. Notes that it was pulled for technical faults and is due back.

changelog.title: Home feed refresh — live event calendar
changelog.body: The Upcoming Events calendar now auto-updates from Goodgame's own schedule every day, so it stays current on its own. Latest from GGS is caught up, and the home page has been tidied.

changelog.title: Item Value Finder — icons & cleaner names
changelog.body: Every reward now shows a small in-game icon (troops, tools, equipment, decorations, construction items, tokens & currencies), construction-item and gem names are fixed, and each deal is labelled with a clean vendor (Hall of Legends, Nomad shop, Rift Raid shop…) instead of dev labels.

changelog.title: Rift Courtyard Calculator
changelog.body: New calculator: will your courtyard hit clear the rift boss's CY, and what will it cost? Pick a boss & level, set your wave once and toggle your pre-battle tools — calibrated against real Fungal L10–L12 battle reports (±13% on losses).

changelog.title: Six new tools + a tidier Calculators page
changelog.body: Added the Buildings overview, Building Upgrade Cost & Time, Recruitment Speed Caps, Equipment Set-Bonus Finder, a native Hall of Legends Planner and a device-local Timer Board. The three Rift calculators now lead the Calculators page under Feature Calculators.

changelog.title: Rift Wall-Break Simulator — calibrated
changelog.body: The wall-break sim is now tuned against two full Level 11 boss reports — breach waves land exactly and losses within a few percent. Kills now accelerate as a wall thins, the front takes both rams and ladders, gear reduction splits into gate and wall, and unit stats read straight off the Troops overview by level. No more guessing.

changelog.title: Misc Tools — Fortress & Name Changes now public
changelog.body: Fortress Tracker (live cooldowns, last attacker, your personal 72h timer) and Name Changes (catch the renamers) moved out of the gated area into a new Misc Tools section — open to everyone.

changelog.title: References & community sheets
changelog.body: New: Maximise Recruitment guide, Courtyard Limits and Name Change Pricing references, plus hosted community sheets (CI costs, WoA 2024 odds).

changelog.title: All overviews complete
changelog.body: Four new overviews: Troops & Tools (461 units + 255 tools with real stats), Generals (full ability kits), Loot Boxes (46 boxes with real drop chances) and Event Rewards (milestone tracks for 20 events).

changelog.title: Auto-updating data
changelog.body: All tool data now refreshes automatically every day — and after game maintenances — straight from the community data cache.

changelog.title: Smarter Rift optimizer
changelog.body: The Rift Commander Maker now builds the strongest loadout by weighted combat value — range/melee/courtyard attack first, then unit limit, then strength — and shows the combat totals. Rift-only sets (no PvP/castellan).

changelog.title: Accurate event art
changelog.body: Every event in the homepage plan now uses the in-game icon. Fixed missing Victorious hero images in the Equipment Overview.

changelog.title: Guides
changelog.body: New Guides section — start with Getting Started, Combat Basics, Attack Commander Setup and Rift Raid Basics. Searchable like any tool.

changelog.title: Events plan with real art
changelog.body: The homepage events row now uses in-game event art, and the whole feed (news, changelog, events) updates from one data file.

changelog.title: Rift Raid Bosses
changelog.body: All 3 bosses, 20 levels each, with per-stage wall garrisons and boss effects. Rift Commander Maker now shows real piece art and exact gem names.

changelog.title: Equipment Overview
changelog.body: 617 gear pieces with full effect lists and real art, including Hero-slot commander portraits. Gacha Sim drops link straight here.

changelog.title: Decorations Overview
changelog.body: 532 decorations with images. Default sort is Decoration Points.

changelog.title: Gacha Spin Simulator
changelog.body: Real drop rates across 5 game versions, with pulls-to-get targeting.

changelog.title: Attack Speed & Detection
changelog.body: Travel time, horse boosts and the exact detection window.
